description:
Create a presentation deck from text content using AI.

Provide raw text (article, report, meeting notes, data) and AI will automatically generate a multi-slide presentation with professional layout, typography, and design.

The generated deck includes:
- Cover slide with title and date
- Content slides with cards, quotes, bullet points
- Summary slide with key takeaways
- Consistent color theme and typography

Supports dark and light themes. Each slide is 1280×720px (16:9).

Use cases:
- Convert blog posts or articles into presentation decks
- Generate IR (Investor Relations) decks from company data
- Create trend briefings from research notes
- Turn meeting minutes into shareable slide summaries

content.description: Raw text content to convert into a presentation deck (10-50,000 chars). Can be plain text, markdown, or structured notes.

name.description: Deck title (max 200 chars). If omitted, auto-generated from content.

name: create_deck
